ranked.title: Personal Income and Outlays, April 2026
ranked.why_it_matters: Personal income decreased less than $0.1 billion (less than 0.1 percent at a monthly rate) in April, according to estimates released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA). Disposable personal income (DPI)-personal income less personal current taxes-decreased $19.9 billion (0.1 percent), and personal consumption expenditures (PCE) increased $111.1 billion (0.5 percent). Personal outlays-the sum of PCE, personal interest payments, and personal current transfer payments-increased $114.0 billion in April. Personal saving was $611.7 billion in April, and the personal saving rate-personal saving as a percentage of DPI-was 2.6 percent. Full Text

ranked.title: GDP (Second Estimate) and Corporate Profits, 1st Quarter 2026

In the fourth quarter of 2025, real GDP increased 0.5 percent. The contributors to the increase in real GDP in the first quarter were exports, investment, consumer spending, and government spending. Imports, which are a subtraction in the calculation of GDP, increased. Full Text

ranked.title: U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services, March 2026

The services surplus increased $1.6 billion in March to $28.4 billion. Full Text

ranked.title: Direct Investment by Country and Industry, 2024

_README.title: S&P 500 Options Whale Trades
_README.description: Large OTM options trades detected over 5 trading days for S&P 500 constituents
_README.purpose: Identify institutional-sized options bets for sentiment analysis and trade ideas

methodology.lookback_type: Trading days (excludes weekends and NYSE holidays)
methodology.moneyness_filter: OTM only (>2% out of the money)
methodology.threshold_approach: Dynamic - starts at $100K minimum, steps up until <= 10 trades per ticker

field_descriptions.dte: Days to expiration from collection date
field_descriptions.moneyness_pct: How far OTM the option is (negative = OTM)
field_descriptions.vol_oi_pct: Trade size as percentage of estimated open interest
field_descriptions.is_sweep: True if trade is part of a detected sweep order
field_descriptions.sweep_id: Identifier linking trades in the same sweep
field_descriptions.effective_threshold: The dynamic threshold applied to this ticker

sentiment_interpretation.BULLISH: Call buying - betting stock price will increase
sentiment_interpretation.BEARISH: Put buying - betting stock price will decrease

dte_bucket_descriptions.0dte: Expiring today - YOLO bets, very aggressive

_README.update_schedule: Daily at Noon ET (mid-market) and 9 PM ET (post-market)

top_bullish_trades.description: Top 10 tickers with largest call trades (one per ticker, bullish bets)

top_bearish_trades.description: Top 10 tickers with largest put trades (one per ticker, bearish bets)

_README.title: S&P 500 Stock Whale Trades
_README.description: Large stock trades detected over 5 trading days for S&P 500 constituents
_README.purpose: Identify institutional-sized stock trades for sentiment analysis, particularly dark pool activity

methodology.lookback_type: Trading days (excludes weekends and NYSE holidays)
methodology.threshold_approach: Dynamic - starts at 5K shares/$1M minimum, steps up until <= 10 trades per ticker
methodology.threshold_logic: Trade qualifies if shares >= threshold OR value >= threshold (OR logic)
methodology.direction_inference: Lee-Ready algorithm - compares trade price to bid/ask spread

field_descriptions.shares: Number of shares in the trade
field_descriptions.value: Dollar value of the trade (price × shares)
field_descriptions.is_dark_pool: True if trade executed on dark pool (Exchange D)
field_descriptions.effective_threshold: The dynamic threshold applied to this ticker

direction_interpretation.BUY: Trade executed at/above ask - aggressive buyer lifted offer
direction_interpretation.SELL: Trade executed at/below bid - aggressive seller hit bid

_README.dark_pool_context:
Dark pool trades (Exchange D) execute off-exchange to minimize market impact.
These are typically institutional block trades where large players don't want
to reveal their positioning to the market. High dark pool activity often
indicates significant institutional interest or repositioning.
_README.update_schedule: Daily at Noon ET (mid-market) and 9 PM ET (post-market)
